arguments.method: Editable projected polygons and window motifs, world centimetres at 1 px/cm; fixed orthographic three-quarter azimuth35 elevation24. Heights sourced, local dimensions photo estimated. No scenery or background.

whole.requirement: Entire Taipei 101 from base to spire; distinctive realistic silhouette, no broad schematic simplification.
whole.description: Complete isolated building, eight flaring tiers, tapering lower base, crown and full needle.

view.requirement: Fixed elevated three-quarter view looking down, visible top surfaces and consistent perspective.
view.description: All visible surfaces share one projection and coherent occlusion.

detail.requirement: Highly detailed editable façade, window frames and visible ornamentation.
detail.description: Inspect base, repeated tier windows and ornament, crown and spire at useful detail scale.

material.description: Teal reflective glass, metallic frames, lit and shaded faces, terrace and ledge shadows.

scale.requirement: Real-world dimensions 1cm=1px before projection; projected lengths reflect angle.
scale.description: 50800cm tip, 44800cm roof, nominal local measurements distinguished from estimates, projection scale1.

editable.description: Native vector faces and individually editable façade elements, no raster insertion.

referenceDecisions.reason: 建築師提供的全樓空拍圖適合確認輪廓與退縮組織，不足以測量局部窗格。

limitations: 不同相機方位；不描繪背景城市
局部尺寸為估計，不作施工圖

referenceDecisions.reason: Alton Thompson 的如意近照適合金屬浮雕外形比較。

limitations: 局部細節以可編輯圖形重建，不是逐像素複製
